steps.do: Read the handoffs, evidence and process records, and list each kind of work done three or more times with no process record, most runs first.
Ask the founder which of that recurring work matters most and who owns each, one owner per process.
Draft a process record for each, with its trigger, inputs, outputs, steps, control points and measures from the handoffs.
Ask whether anything has failed in a way the founder wants never to repeat, and draft a postmortem for each.
Summarize the process catalog for the strategy lead: each process, its owner and health, and the bottleneck to work first.

done_criteria.check: Does every process record name exactly one owner and cite the handoffs its measures came from?
